away.name: Jacob Markstrom
away.news: The Panthers have been riddled with injuries early in the 2026-27 season, but newcomer Jacob Markstrom has given them a chance on most nights. That said, the 36-year-old Swedish goalie is coming off his first regulation loss, allowing three goals on 28 shots (.893 SV%) in a 4-1 loss to the Minnesota Wild. He has a 1.70 GAA and .916 SV% in four games this season (2-1-1). The Panthers enter Monday's contest as slight +101 road underdogs against a Buffalo Sabres team that has been outscored 11-19 through five games (2-3-0).

home.name: Colten Ellis
home.news: Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen hasn't provided adequate goaltending for the Sabres early this season, so they will hope for a better return on Monday as Ellis tends the twine against the Florida Panthers. The 26-year-old Ellis was serviceable in his two outings this season (1-1-0), saving 44 of 50 shots (.880 SV%). Ellis made his NHL debut last season, posting a 2.90 GAA and .903 SV% in 16 appearances (8-4-2). The Sabres enter Monday's contest as -112 home favourites against a Panthers team that has scored only nine goals in five games (2-1-2).

away.name: Linus Ullmark
away.news: Ullmark has been outstanding to start the 2026-27 season and will return to the crease on Monday against the New Jersey Devils. The 33-year-old Swedish goalie has won all four of his outings, posting a dazzling 1.34 GAA and .942 SV%. That said, the Senators enter Monday's contest as slight +110 road underdogs against a New Jersey Devils team coming off a 4-1 win over the Vancouver Canucks.

home.name: Nico Daws
home.news: The 2-2-0 Devils have had an up-and-down start to the 2026-27 season and will likely turn to Daws to tend the twine on Monday against the Ottawa Senators. The 25-year-old Daws had a poor outing in his only game this season, allowing six goals on 32 shots (.813 SV%) in a one-sided 6-0 loss to the New York Islanders. The Devils enter Monday's contest as -126 home favourites against a Senators team that has won four of their first five games (4-1-0).

home.name: Jesper Wallstedt
home.news: With Filip Gustavsson (hip) sidelined, Minnesota has started Wallstedt in every game of the 2026-27 season and will continue that trend on Monday against the Vegas Golden Knights. The 23-year-old Wallstedt has given Head Coach John Hynes no reason to deviate, posting a stellar 1.78 GAA and .936 SV% in five outings (3-1-1). Minnesota enters the action on Monday as slight -103 home underdogs against a Vegas team off to a hot 5-1-0 start to the season.
